messages:
Ashley: @here quick sync? we need to finalize audit-ingest shape for BYOK pilot — retention buckets, search SLA, and how KMS escrow affects exports. :wave:
Tim: Can you share the concrete asks from legal/enterprise? high-level 'we need 7y logs' is different than 'searchable 90 days'.
Ashley: Legal wants traceability for SOC2 & ISO. Customer A asked for searchable audit for 365d, cold-archive up to 7y with exportable evidence on demand. They also require BYOK key escrow + rotation windows.
Sara: FYI customer A says they will only sign if export can be done within 48h and includes key proofchain. that's non-negotiable.
Leo: From infra side: searchable index for 365d is expensive. Options: hot index (90d) + warm (275d) with a daily reindex snapshot. Cold archive (7y) → S3 with manifest. Search SLA: 2min for hot, 1-6 hours for warm, export prep within 24-72h depending on size.
Pia: Security constraints: BYOK means we don't have plaintext keys. Escrow/escrowless patterns matter. If customer wants 'proofchain' we need signed key metadata + attestations. Also need to scope who can request exports (legal/owner only).
Tim: Can we propose an MVP: - Hot-search 90d SLA 2m, warm-search 275d best-effort 24h, cold-archive 7y export 72h; BYOK supported but escrow optional w/ additional engineering + legal. Agree?
Ashley: I like the tradeoff. Product needs clear launch criteria: 1) export format defined and tested, 2) RBAC controls + audit trail for export requests, 3) KMS handshake doc + HSM compatibility note.
Leo: Engineering asks: ETA to implement hot+warm tiers w/ migration + index pruning ~6w if we reuse existing telemetry pipeline. BYOK escrow integration ~4w extra (legal + ops approvals).
Sara: Put me on the critical path for customer comms. If we accept the 72h export window we keep them. We should also offer 'expedited export' as paid add-on with 24h SLA and higher cost.
Pia: One more: SOC2 requirement — evidence chain must show immutability. We'll need an append-only digest (sig) per snapshot. Implementation detail: signed manifest stored in keystore + hash in audit logs.
Ashley: OK action items: 1) Tim to draft launch criteria doc, 2) Leo to scope infra tasks + cost estimate, 3) Pia to draft security acceptance and escrow options, 4) Sara to draft customer agreement language. We'll huddle tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
Tim: I'll drop a PRD stub in #product-docs today and link it here.
ops-bot: Scheduled: sync reminder posted for tomorrow 10:00 in #product. (automated)
Sara: quick note — pricing ops wants ballpark monthly cost delta for hot vs warm indexing before the PRD.
Leo: I'll add a cost table to the scope doc (estimates for tokens/storage/ingest CPU).
